verdict.rationale: `ultrametric init` writes skill files into the project for both Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills), and the docs say to commit those files to share the setup with the team, which delivers the committed-files path. A keyless dry-run probe confirmed both target paths. missing for 10: any marketplace or plugin-registry distribution, the ability to bundle more than Ultrametric's own single skill into a team-defined standard set, and a hands-on observation of an actual write-and-commit rather than only a dry-run preview.
